messages:
grace: Morning async — quick checkin
What I did: landed the new routing-policy v2 schema (adds `priority_tier` + per-route rate hints) and merged the rate-limiter refactor to staging.
Blockers: seeing intermittent 429 spikes on /v1/generate in staging when the cache is cold + burst traffic; can't reproduce locally.
Today: triage 429s, add more metrics around KV cache miss rates, and cut a tiny canary with a faster backoff. Will ping infra for an e2e run.

omar: thanks — can you paste a minimal repro curl? I can spin up a quick locust script if you share.

grace: sure — quick curl I used against staging:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer test-token' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"prompt":"x","max_tokens":64}'
```
I ran that in 100 concurrent clients with a 50ms think time.

sasha: I ran a narrower load: 40 clients, burst 5s windows. I reproduced elevated 429s and saw `kv_cache_miss_ratio` jump from 0.06 -> 0.42 during warmup. Also noticed a few `open_file_limit` warnings in gateway logs.

tess: quick PR notes — left comments on backoff math and added a small test request for the `priority_tier` field. If we change the default backoff we should add a migration for dedicated pools.

liam: FYI I kicked off a staging deploy for the latest canary a few mins ago. (reacted with :rocket:)

build-bot: Deploy succeeded: staging/gateway canary v2.3.4 — 6/6 pods ready. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9876 (link). :white_check_mark:

omar: i'll pair with grace on the repro. plan: 1) reproduce with locust, 2) add KV miss tagging to the request trace, 3) run a single-route canary with throttles tuned.

grace: sg. action items: @omar run locust & dump traces; @sasha check node ulimits + share logs; @tess merge the small PR after tests; i'll prepare canary config with faster backoff and lower initial burst.

sasha: noted — i'll upload logs to the thread if I find more warnings.

liam: if you need capacity quickly I can open a short-term additional pool, but would prefer to tune first. :eyes:

grace: thanks all — i'll update here after first locust run (ETA ~45m).
